The build passes now. Exit code is 0.

## The two real bugs

The bump broke two link-stage call sites. They were sequential, so the first error hid the second.

1. `src/core/options.js:6` — the options object renamed `retries` to `retryCount`. This call site still read `options.retries`, which was `undefined`, so `.toFixed(0)` threw a `TypeError`. It now reads `retryCount`, falls back to `retries`, and rejects a non-numeric value with a clear message.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js:7` — the old config loader returned `false` for an unset flag. The new loader returns `undefined`. The strict check accepted only `true` or `false`, so it threw on every unset flag. Unset now means off, which matches the old behavior. A non-boolean value still throws.

## The remaining 8 warnings

They are noise from the build harness, not from your source. `build.js` prints them as fixed strings (`build.js:18-24` and `build.js:46-48`), and they name files such as `src/legacy/adapter.js` that do not exist in this tree. Only `src/core/options.js` and `src/net/retryPolicy.js` hold real code here.

So the count stays at 8 warnings. I can delete those lines from `build.js`, but that only hides output and fixes nothing. If the warnings come from a real bundler in your full repo, point me at that checkout and I will work through them.
